_purpose: A first page-level reading, by Claude (the shape-check agent of the census session), of each open shape-fail of grid-shape-check.json (the fifteenth amendment). It says whether the stored grid is misaligned, with the printed cells, and the figure the page supports. It is not a verdict and not a register: each record still goes to two independent readings before anything is repaired.
read: 13 October 2026, from the filings' text layer, the extraction's OCR page cache, or the page image
